design_disclosure: A public-output observer transferred between existing checkpoints on identical APPS rows. Not a self-improved model, not internal-mechanism transfer, and not fresh inference. Previously stored outcomes informed the broad question. Calibration subsets and all fitting choices are fixed before this transfer run; all budgets and seeds are reported. Positive affine recalibration cannot change a top-budget ranking and is a mathematical no-change control.
tie_handling: shared random row order before stable descending score sort
